title: Getting paid before you touch the car

brief.idea:
Write every slide in English.

Headline: Getting paid before you touch the car

Subhead: Your income is exactly as lumpy as your calendar, but it does not have to be.

Reader: Studio owners doing repeat maintenance work (monthly washes, seasonal decontamination) who are paid job-by-job and feel every quiet week

Facts you may state (and ONLY these):
- A package is defined by the studio: a session count, a price, an optional studio-set discount and an optional validity window.
- The client buys the package themselves and pays by card — the purchase record stores the Stripe PaymentIntent that paid for it.
- Packages can also be assigned manually by the studio, in which case there is no payment intent and no transaction economics recorded.
- Redemption is tracked as usedSessions against totalSessions on the customer's package, with an optional expiresAt.
- The studio's net proceeds are the price the client paid minus a platform commission, and both figures are recorded on the purchase.
- Prepaid session packages are an Advanced-plan feature.

Close with a call to action asking the reader to DM the keyword PACKAGE.

Do not invent CLAIMS of any kind: no statistics, no facts, no list items the source above does not contain. Compress the given sentences — cut words, never substitute your own. When the source presents a list as ordered, keep its order and do not add or drop items.

Lead with the reader's problem, not with the product.

parseUser:
BRAND VOICE: Quietly confident and aspirational, addressing the studio owner directly with understated elegance — evocative fragments over hype, with a flash of urgency when revenue is on the line.
PHOTOGRAPHY: this brand is carried by its images — most slides that show a place, a product, a person or a result should ask for one.
DO: Speak to 'you' and 'your studio'; Short, evocative fragments; Concrete business outcomes (bookings, rebookings, revenue); Let restraint imply premium
DON'T: Exclamation marks; Tech jargon; Overt hype or ALL-CAPS shouting; Generic SaaS clichés
SLIDES: exactly 0 — one per SLIDE PLAN entry, in that order. Do not add a slide the plan did not ask for, and do not merge two.
BRIEF: Write every slide in English.
